org.name: Bhutan Centre for Media and Democracy
org.vision: A vibrant democracy where citizens are engaged and proactive
org.mission: To nurture democracy in Bhutan through civic engagement, public discourse and media literacy

hero.imageAlt: Participants in traditional gho tie strings together during a BCMD Active Citizens engagement activity in Thimphu.

values.name: Teamwork
values.definition: Work as a team in a spirit of mutual respect, cooperation, and equality.

values.name: Integrity
values.definition: Be accountable and transparent, take responsibility for everything we do.

values.name: Participation
values.definition: Engage in society, share views, stay informed, be of service to others.

values.name: Innovation
values.definition: Encourage independence and creativity, promote innovative problem-solving.

values.name: Leadership
values.definition: Take responsibility to lead oneself, develop the capacity to lead others through inspiration, not authority.

values.name: Personal Development
values.definition: Engage in continuous learning to better serve community and society.

programmes.title: Empowering Accountable, Active & Responsible Citizens
programmes.intro: Democracy is only as strong as its citizens' participation. The Centre's programme aims to empower citizens, young and old alike, to engage in the democratic process beyond elections … BCMD focuses on inspiring and enabling people to be more participatory and engaged in their communities.
activities: Youth Summit — an annual reflection and self-discovery programme
Youth Initiative — a year-long programme teaching investigation, policy review, debate, deliberation and dialogue
programmes.audience: Youth, teachers, local leaders, residents, parliamentarians, political parties, CSOs
programmes.imageAlt: Participants at a BCMD Youth Summit workshop reviewing notes together outdoors.

programmes.title: Creating Knowledge Resources for Citizens
programmes.intro: BCMD produces Bhutan-centric resources that amplify Bhutanese views and perspectives in print, multimedia and a variety of media platforms … distributed to educational institutes, libraries, government agencies and parliamentary institutions.
activities: The Druk Journal — a bi-annual publication plus conversations, at drukjournal.bt
Creative Multimedia Productions — photo essays, films, PSAs, posters, podcasts
programmes.audience: Youth, teachers, local leaders, parliamentarians, political parties, public servants, CSOs
programmes.imageAlt: Cover of The Druk Journal, Volume 5 Issue 2, Autumn 2019 — “Tourism in Bhutan.”

programmes.title: Media Lab — Enabling Citizen Voice
programmes.intro: BCMD's Media Lab is a learning space for youths, amateur photographers, filmmakers, teachers, thought leaders and media professionals to learn creative skills of photography, design and film-making and to exercise their voice positively.
activities: Media Course — production and news literacy
Youth Camps — the base for the Youth Initiative
programmes.audience: Youth, teachers, local leaders, parliamentarians, political parties, CSOs
programmes.imageAlt: Four young monks seated on stone steps practising with cameras during a Media Lab basic photography course.
